title: Add /api/stats endpoint to the board server
description: board/server.py currently serves /api/tasks but /api/stats 404s (the header shows a fallback count). Implement GET /api/stats returning JSON: {"total": int, "statuses": {<status>: count}, "phases": {<phase>: count}} computed from load_tasks(). Match existing style, minimal diff, stdlib only. Verify: python3 -m py_compile board/server.py && BOARD_PORT=8877 python3 board/server.py in background, curl -sf localhost:8877/api/stats, then kill it. Governing skill: skills/sdlc/sdlc-implement/SKILL.md + skills/meta/karpathy-guidelines/SKILL.md.
